Method of Attack: Remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability exploitation via preview methods allowing unauthenticated users to insert and execute malicious payloads
E-skimming attacks by Magecart groups injecting payment card skimming scripts
Impacted Systems: Magento Commerce 2.3.2 (if security-only patch 2.3.2-p2 not installed)
Unsupported versions of Page Builder (e.g., Page Builder Beta)
Magento Commerce cloud customers (protected but affected by preview functionality block)
Attack Vector: Exploitation of RCE vulnerability in preview methods
Injection of payment card skimming scripts into checkout pages
Indicators of Compromise: Magecart skimmer script detections (2,086,529 instances reported by RiskIQ telemetry)
Injected payment card skimming scripts in PrismWeb-powered checkout pages
Polymorphic Magecart skimmer script supporting 57 payment gateways
